product.name: Odesa Arc 1200mm Fluted California Walnut Floorstanding Vanity Unit and Walnut Countertop
product.finish: Fluted California Walnut / Matching Walnut Countertop
product.notes: Floorstanding Odesa Arc 1200mm vanity in fluted California Walnut with a matching walnut countertop. The 1200mm unit is visually formed as two side-by-side drawer banks, each with two drawer fronts (four visible drawer fronts total), with integrated milled handles, soft-close hardware and rounded Arc outer corners. Basin, taps and accessories are not included. Planner geometry uses 1200mm width and 855 x 424mm height/depth as the current working dimensions; verify final dimensions against the retailer specification before ordering. Dedicated 3D profile models the 2 x 2 drawer layout, centre join, light California Walnut finish, subtle fluting, rounded outer corners, inset plinth and matching walnut countertop. The planner also supports a visual alternate top style of a double ceramic basin top inspired by the user reference image.
